topic: The 20-second handwashing habit that stops germs spreading

scenes.line: Five steps. One twenty-second scrub. Here's how.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira faces camera with a warm smile and holds up five fingers; five small numbered teal step chips stack in at the right, a 20 s stopwatch badge at the left
scenes.animation: Hard cut in. Step chips pop in on 'Five' with 0.08 s stagger, scale 0.4 to 1, back.out; stopwatch badge scales in on 'scrub', back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: Step one: wet your hands with clean, running water, warm or cold, and apply soap.
scenes.visual: Large step-1 card: a simple tap with three falling water drops over two open hands; a soap bottle slides in at the side
scenes.animation: Card rises on 'one', power2.out 0.35 s; drops fall in a loop from 'wet'; soap bottle slides in from the right on 'soap', power2.out

scenes.line: Step two: lather. Rub the backs of your hands, between your fingers, and under your nails.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, friendly and focused, mimes rubbing hands; three small label chips at the sides: backs, between fingers, under nails
scenes.animation: Chips pop in on 'backs', 'between' and 'nails', scale 0 to 1, back.out 0.3 s each

scenes.line: Step three: scrub for at least twenty seconds.
scenes.visual: Big circular timer ring in teal with the number 20 in the centre and a soft bubble pattern behind it
scenes.animation: Ring draws clockwise from 0 to full starting on 'scrub', linear over the scene; number 20 scales in on 'twenty', back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: No timer? Hum Happy Birthday twice.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, playful smile, gives a little wave; two music-note badges float up beside the head
scenes.animation: First note badge pops in on 'Happy', second on 'twice', scale 0 to 1, back.out 0.3 s; both bob gently

scenes.line: Step four: rinse well under clean, running water.
scenes.visual: Step-4 card: two hands under a tap with a stream of water lines and small bubbles sliding off
scenes.animation: Card rises on 'four', power2.out 0.35 s; water stream lines draw down on 'rinse'; bubbles drift downward and fade

scenes.line: Step five: dry with a clean towel or an air dryer.
scenes.visual: Step-5 card split in two: a folded towel on the left, an air-dryer outline with airflow lines on the right
scenes.animation: Towel slides in on 'towel', dryer slides in on 'air', power2.out 0.3 s; airflow lines pulse

scenes.line: Clean hands help stop germs spreading.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, warm reassuring nod, open palms; a soft shield badge with a hand outline at the upper right
scenes.animation: Shield badge scales in on 'stop', back.out 0.35 s

scenes.line: Wash before you eat, after the toilet, and after you cough, sneeze, or blow your nose.
scenes.visual: Three rounded cards in a row: plate with fork, toilet outline, tissue box
scenes.animation: Cards slide up one by one on 'eat', 'toilet' and 'cough', stagger, power2.out 0.35 s

scenes.line: Save this, and share it with someone you live with.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, direct friendly gaze, waves; a bookmark icon and a share-arrow badge appear above the shoulders
scenes.animation: Bookmark bounces in on 'Save', share badge pops in on 'share', back.out 0.3 s

scenes.visual: Cream end card with Pulse Health wordmark centred
scenes.onScreenText: Not medical advice. Sources: CDC, NHS
